scheme_name: Incentive Award to Inter-Caste Married Couples
other_conditions: Both bride and groom must be Indian citizens
Marriage must be between a Scheduled Caste member and a member of any other community
It must be the first marriage between the bride and groom
Either the bride or the groom (or both) should be a native of Puducherry
Application must be submitted within 60 days of the marriage date
benefits_summary: Award of ₹50,000, comprising ₹20,000 in cash and ₹30,000 as a National Savings Certificate.
